input.title: feat: retain SWF button display states
input.body:
## Summary

Retain button placement data needed by the following creator-controls slices. This five-file PR is stacked on #44; creator rendering and gestures follow separately.

```text
SWF button record
  state bits + matrix + color + supported glow/blend
    buttonDisplayList(up | over | down | hit)
      depth-sorted static placements
```

Hit-only geometry stays outside ordinary painted states. Matrix/color readers already finish on byte boundaries; remove redundant alignment, stale comments and the unused filter skipper. Action presence remains metadata; no ActionScript executes.

## Evidence

- **Before:** Two new parser regressions fail because matrices and track-as-menu data are discarded.
  **After:** Four tests pass, covering translated DefineButton1 records, DefineButton2 alpha and placement conversion, state/depth separation, and retained glow/blend data after an unsupported filter without corrupting the following record.
- An independent Python bit reader exactly matches all 37 shipped buttons and 133 state records, including every matrix and complete tag terminators. All shipped definitions are DefineButton2 and have identity color with no filters, blend, track-as-menu or actions; those extra branches have synthetic coverage.
- Formatting, TypeScript, 479 rule tests (6,004 assertions), production build and both native import/navigation flows pass (34.7 seconds, no skips), including compressed CWS and tank-code sharing.
- The display-state API has no production UI caller yet. Unsupported filter types are consumed by the existing parser, while only supported glow metadata is retained. Original artwork remains runtime supplied. Parsing checks do not establish creator appearance, Flash input behavior or full parity.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes the extra metadata and unused display-state API. No profile or generated-data changes.

**Blast Radius:** parsing

The native asset inventory uses the enriched parser; both affected SWF-loading paths pass. Existing creator controls remain unchanged.

## Summary

Connect the retained menu picker from merged #43 to production input. Mouse actions now follow current painted geometry and release targets, including title occlusion and hover growth.

```text
pointer position / keyboard focus
  MenuPointer → native retained pose or mock contour
    changed target → hover, caption, cursor
    left mouse-up → one guarded action
stage draw → refresh stationary pointer against new art
```

Preserve keyboard buttons, current layout-phase callbacks, series bubbling/reversal, caption formatting and mock alpha. Registered release targets clear the caption before the busy guard. Offline actions and unavailable-site feedback remain unchanged.

## Evidence

- **Before:** DOM rectangles supplied hover/click behavior; visible native title art and grown inner clips did not determine action targets.
  **After:** Native input matches all 12 target-bearing source observations, rejects six control corners and icon-only releases, blocks Settings through the intro title, and accepts its hover-grown edge beyond the DOM button.
- Scaled-stage outside-press releases, exactly-once dispatch, right-button rejection, physical hover after keyboard blur and Tab/Enter routes are covered in native and mock cases.
- Ordinary navigation waits for the native title to stop. The existing series test now enters with actual Tab input rather than programmatic focus after a mouse click; all frame, reversal, alpha and offline-link assertions remain.
- Validation: formatting, TypeScript, 475 rule tests (5,992 assertions), production build and all 70 selected browser cases pass (8.2 minutes; 14 native and 56 mock/synthetic, no skips). Original media remain runtime supplied; native tests require the local research SWF. Exact Adobe event phase and full parity remain open. The fixed Play/Tutorial hint is recorded as a remaining conditional-preference difference.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores DOM menu dispatch. No profile migration or serialized data changes.

**Blast Radius:** input

All menu mouse actions now share the geometry service; keyboard access and retained overlay guards remain covered by browser tests.

   name=bytearray()

input.body:
## Summary

Recover the creator's numerical layout before connecting its controls. This seven-file slice is stacked on #45; selection behavior and native/mock UI follow separately.

```text
supplied SWF root969
  import-creator-controls.ts
    11 controls + Resize/Rotate + workspace
      numeric bounds, matrices, colors and label advances
        core/creator-controls.ts
```

Keep separate text-paint and declared-bounds matrices so the text transform is applied once in each use. Add an optional button-array type to the existing symbol result; runtime AssetPack behavior is unchanged. The import exports no paths, font outlines, images or audio.

## Evidence

- **Before:** Applying the text matrix to its already-transformed declared bounds enlarges Undo to 88.5×23px in a controlled importer variant.
  **After:** The importer retains the source-backed 58×23px rectangle at (−0.5,−0.5). Literal tests keep the separate paint/bounds transforms and original Undo assertion.
- Two repeat imports match the backlog JSON exactly: 69,147 bytes, SHA256 `a95a22e13a3f9fcb1df294d722cfabfa6ea7001cbfe0ca8c270346d7c93645ec`.
- An independent raw-tag reader verifies all 11 control placements, both sliders, workspace registration, both handles and Undo's shape/text rectangles and internal text matrix.
- Formatting, TypeScript, 482 rule tests (6,030 assertions) and production build pass. The data is not connected to the application yet, so this slice changes no browser flow.
- Primitive colors/strokes are representative data, not complete contours, gradients or filter paint. Native/mock control rendering, input and complete creator/game parity remain unverified.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes unused metadata and its importer. No profile or saved-design changes.

**Blast Radius:** metadata

The new module is consumed only by its tests at this stage. Creator input and painting remain for following PRs.
